ns2:course.label: Experimental Microbiology
ns2:course.description: (MCBIO 201) Laboratory emphasizing the fundamentals of microbiology. Topics include growth, isolation, and identification of bacteria; restriction endonuclease analysis of DNA, genetic cloning, and gene transfer. Computer methods are used for the identification of microorganisms and for the analysis of recombinant DNA molecules. Prerequisite: Credit or concurrent registration in MCB 300, and MCB 250 and MCB 251, and credit or concurrent registration in MCB 252 and MCB 253, or consent of instructor.
